column3: I made a final decision to buy this laptop. (我做出了購買這台筆電的最終決定。)
The manager will announce the new office hours today. (經理今天會宣布新的辦公時間。)
Please check the official website for more information. (請查看官方網站以獲取更多資訊。)
You need to obtain a permit to park here. (你需要獲得許可證才能在這裡停車。)
Can you confirm your email address for the booking? (你能確認一下預訂用的電子郵件地址嗎？)
It is easy to operate this coffee machine. (操作這台咖啡機很容易。)
The company wants to promote its new product line. (公司想要宣傳他們的新產品系列。)
We need to get some legal advice before signing. (簽署前我們需要尋求一些法律建議。)
It is not nice to mock people for their mistakes. (因為別人的錯誤而嘲笑他們是不好的。)
The band gave a great performance last night. (樂團昨晚有很棒的表演。)
